messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

team.description: Optionally the specific team to consider. Eg. Liverpool

message.content:
**All‑time Premier League assist leaders**

| Rank | Player          | Club(s)                     | Total Assists |
|------|-----------------|-----------------------------|---------------|
| **1** | *Ryan Giggs*    | Manchester United           | **162**       |
| 2   | *Frank Lampard* | Chelsea / Middlesbrough     | 147           |
| 3   | *David Silva*   | Tottenham Hotspur / Man Utd | 140           |

> **Ryan Giggs** – With 162 assists over his 24‑year career from 1990‑91 to 2014‑15, Giggs still sits atop the all‑time list. He surpassed former record holders such as Paul Scholes (139) and Steven Gerrard (136).

---

### Single‑Season Assist Record

| Season | Player            | Team                | Assists |
|--------|-------------------|---------------------|---------|
| 2019‑20 | *Kevin De Bruyne* | Manchester City     | **20**  |
| 2019‑20 | *James Milner*    | Liverpool           | 20      |
| 2019‑20 | *Bruno Fernandes* | Manchester United   | 20      |

*(These three players shared the modern era record of 20 assists in one Premier League campaign.)*

Historically, before the 2019‑20 season the best single‑season tally was 16, held jointly by:

| Year | Players                 | Clubs               | Assists |
|------|--------------------------|--------------------|---------|
| 2005‑06 | *Thierry Henry*, *Steven Gerrard* | Arsenal & Liverpool | 16 each |

So while **Ryan Giggs** remains the greatest ever contributor of chances, the contemporary benchmark for an outstanding assisting season is **20 assists**, a figure first broken by Kevin De Bruyne in 2019‑20 and subsequently equalled by two teammates.
